summary: Tested mobile gesture features: navigation dots, swipe navigation wrapper, pull-to-refresh, and session review tab swipe. Found and fixed a bug where navigation dots were visible on all viewports instead of only mobile (<768px). All features now working correctly.

navigation_dots_mobile.details: Navigation dots visible at bottom on mobile viewport (<768px) on main pages (Home, Coaches, Templates, Calendar, Settings)

navigation_dots_count.details: 5 navigation dots displayed correctly representing the 5 main pages

navigation_dots_click.details: Clicking dots navigates to correct pages (/templates, /calendar, /settings)

navigation_dots_active_indicator.details: Active page indicator shows correctly (1 dot with w-4 class for current page)

navigation_dots_responsive.details: Fixed bug - navigation dots now hide on desktop (>=768px) and show only on mobile

pull_to_refresh_container.details: PullToRefresh component container exists on My Coaches page with indicator element

swipeable_page_wrapper.details: SwipeablePageWrapper correctly wraps main pages and provides swipe gesture detection

session_review_tabs_swipe.details: useSwipeTabs hook correctly implemented in ReviewSession.jsx for Summary/Reflections/Analysis tabs - mobile only

navigation_dots_viewport_bug.issue: Navigation dots were visible on all viewports (desktop/tablet) due to isMobile being calculated at render time without resize listener
navigation_dots_viewport_bug.fix: Added useState and useEffect with resize event listener in SwipeablePageWrapper.jsx to dynamically update isMobile state

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile gesture features all working: 1) Navigation dots at bottom on mobile main pages (5 dots for Home/Coaches/Templates/Calendar/Settings), 2) Swipe navigation between main pages, 3) Pull-to-refresh container on data pages, 4) Tab swipe on Review Session page. Fixed viewport responsiveness bug - now correctly shows dots only on mobile. Note: Admin users are redirected to /admin on Home, but navigation dots still work for navigating to other pages.
